text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell in this session, so none of the fixes have been run against the suite. I checked each fix by reading it against the tests.

- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the days late instead of multiplying (`+` changed to `*`).
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. The tests and the policy comment both say 5.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events. It now returns the last `n`, or an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added it as `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it with `int()`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm.
